group_node.description: One editor-tree group: a label plus EITHER a list of slot keys (leaf group; for tiered buildings the list order is the level order) OR nested child groups — never both.

label.description: Label the editor shows for this group.

slots.description: Slot entries in this group, in display order. Either a bare key (inherits the category frame size, no display name) or an object form carrying a {frame_w, frame_h} override (D1: slicing != drawing) and/or a display_name. The same key may appear under two groups of ONE category (shared art) but never in two categories, and every occurrence must agree on its frame size (loader-enforced: uniqueItems compares whole values, so it cannot catch a key repeated in both forms).

slot_entry.description: A slots[] entry in object form: a slot key plus, optionally, a frame-size override (D1: how the SHEET is sliced) and/or a display_name (the designer-facing name for this variant, shown wherever the editor lists slots). Use the bare-string form for a slot that needs neither.

display_name.description: Designer-facing name for this slot/variant (editor-only, never read by the game): what the slot editor's Name field writes and what the UI screen editor's skin combos show beside the key. Absent means the key is its own label.

frame_h.description: Sprite frame height in pixels for this slot, overriding the category's.

frame_w.description: Sprite frame width in pixels for this slot, overriding the category's.

description: Slot registry (E-34/D-32): every renderable thing declares an asset slot here — key, frame size, animation vocabulary, editor grouping. Lives at data/slots.json — a DELIBERATE deviation from D-32's literal 'data/schemas/slots.*' path, because tools/smoke.py excludes data/schemas/ from validation and the registry must be validated content.

categories.description: Ordered list of slot categories. Order is meaningful: the editor tree shows categories in this order, and the first five keys mirror the balancing domains (D-10 order).

animations.description: Animation vocabulary offered by the importer for this category; sheet rows are named from this list. First entry is always 'idle' (row 0, E-35).

display_name.description: Label the editor tree shows for this category.

frame_h.description: Sprite frame height in pixels for every slot in this category.

frame_w.description: Sprite frame width in pixels for every slot in this category.

groups.description: Editor grouping tree for this category (e.g. building type -> tier -> level slots).

key.description: Category identifier. When it matches a balancing domain (buildings/enemies/map/ui/core) the editor maps selections in this category to that domain's balancing form.
